headline: 6 things people say
body: Half of them are wrong and the other half are wrong for a different reason.
punch: Number 4 is the one everyone gets backwards.

headline: They say
body: Actually your growth stops first and fusion follows it. Growth decelerates for years before anything closes.
punch: The closed plate is the receipt, not the cause.

headline: They say
body: Actually testosterone is the raw material. Aromatase converts it into estrogen, and estrogen is what drives skeletal maturation and closure.
punch: Androgen is the precursor. Estrogen does the work.

headline: They say
body: Actually different bones run different schedules. Small bones like the metacarpals senesce earlier than femurs, and bone age is read from a hand X-ray.
punch: You're measuring the bones that finish first.

headline: They say
body: Actually the growth plate responds to locally produced IGF-1. That's why cartilage targeted delivery exists as a research programme at all.
punch: Serum IGF-1 is a liver number, not a plate number.

headline: They say
body: Actually suppress growth temporarily and plates grow faster afterwards, because slowing the division rate conserves proliferative capacity.
punch: Catch-up growth shouldn't exist if height ran on a clock.

headline: They say
body: Actually there are four competing theories at the cellular level and none is confirmed in humans. One human study found no classical apoptosis at all.
punch: The mechanism everyone assumes is settled isn't.

headline: It's never over
body: Real mechanisms, real citations, no protocols.
